questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for road hazards. This sign warns you that the road may be wet and slippery. Drive carefully.

questions.question: Motorcycles are entitled to:

options.text: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles must use the full lane width, just like all other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing your path. Wait until the intersection is clear before moving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: Before starting the car, you should:

options.text: Be sure only backseat passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Be sure only adult passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Be sure only child passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Be sure all passengers have buckled their seat belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be sure all passengers have buckled their seat belts.
questions.explanation: Before you start the car, buckle your seat belt and make sure all passengers do the same.

questions.question: When dealing with pedestrians, a driver must:

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian is aware of their vehicle.
Always yield the right-of-way, even if the pedestrian is in the wrong.
Yield the right-of-way only when the pedestrian is legally entitled to it.
Slow down and sound their horn near a crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always yield the right-of-way, even if the pedestrian is in the wrong.
questions.explanation: Do everything possible to avoid hitting a pedestrian, no matter what. Always give pedestrians the right-of-way, even if they are crossing illegally.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: To help prevent crashes, you should:

options.text: Ignore other drivers on the road.
Drive only on side streets and back roads.

questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers do unexpected things. Communicate with other drivers, bicyclists, and pedestrians by signaling when you slow down, stop, or turn. Use your emergency lights or horn when needed.

questions.question: What colors are the signs that show how far away the next exit is?
questions.explanation: Signs that show where you are going are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: Is texting while driving allowed?

options.text: Yes, but it is not safe.
Yes, if you use voice-to-text technology.

questions.explanation: In Ohio, drivers cannot text while driving. Texting while driving is dangerous and can result in fines and loss of your license.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will be divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn coming up.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in school zones?
questions.explanation: Unless a different speed limit is posted, the speed limit in school zones is 20 mph. Always drive carefully in school zones.

questions.question: You are driving and hear a siren behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Move to the right and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle behind you, move to the right side of the road and stop. Make room for the emergency vehicle to pass. If you are in heavy traffic, move slowly until you can get out of the way.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time. What happens?

options.text: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
The vehicle on the right must let the vehicle on the left go first.
Drivers should use hand signals to tell each other what to do.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, vehicles should proceed in the order they arrive. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after stopping completely.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows a law drivers must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What happens if a bicyclist breaks traffic laws?

options.text: Bicyclists do not have to follow traffic laws.
Police will always give them a warning.
Their bicycle will be taken away.

questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights and duties as drivers of cars. Both bicyclists and drivers can be ticketed if they break traffic laws.

questions.question: How much space should you keep between your car and a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Keep at least three seconds of space between your car and a motorcycle. Even a small bump can cause a motorcycle rider to fall or get hurt.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign is a:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are yellow warning signs. They alert drivers to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp turn. Slow down before you reach the turn.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your ability to drive safely. It affects your focus, awareness, judgment, and memory. Do not drink and drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, which one has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car approaching from the right.
The car approaching from the left.
The car in which the driver sounds the horn first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car approaching from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection without traffic signs or signals, you must yield to any vehicle approaching from your right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.
